$comment: Reviewed default price book for the TikHub provider, seeded into the
control plane on first deploy and never overwritten afterwards.
The unit cost is a deliberate provisional baseline. TikHub bills against a
prepaid balance rather than publishing a per-call price, so no contract
figure is known; 1 minor unit (USD 0.01) is carried over from the previous
MX_INSIGHT_TIKHUB_BILLING_JSON example. It exists so a fresh cluster comes
up serving instead of blocked on missing cost evidence.
Once the real per-call cost is known, change it in Admin (Data Cleaning
Center -> External Data Platforms) rather than here -- a running cluster
reads its price from the database, and editing this file has no effect on
it. Until then TikHub procurement totals are provisional.
Budgets are written as CALL COUNTS; the seeder multiplies them by the
operation's highest unit price. They must not be 0: zero rejects every
call Hub absorbs itself with external_platform_cost_budget_exhausted.
